title: ecb-1: add ber_len_decode helper + WP11_PIV_ERR_ENCODING
description: Add a BER-TLV length decoder (ISO 7816-4 §5.2.2) to wp11_proto_piv.c as a static helper. Handles short form (0x00-0x7F), one-byte long form (0x81 prefix), two-byte long form (0x82 prefix). Returns error on indefinite (0x80) or reserved (0xFF) encodings. Also add WP11_PIV_ERR_ENCODING to wp11_proto_piv.h for malformed TLV responses.
